AgentContextKit MCP stdio transport

Usage:
  ackit mcp --stdio-server [--repo <path>] [--lang en|tr]
  ackit mcp --stdio <json-request> [--output <repo-relative.jsonl>] [--lang en|tr]
  ackit mcp --help

Modes:
  --stdio-server   Real stdio loop. Reads JSON-RPC 2.0 line-delimited messages from
                  Console.In and writes JSON-RPC responses to Console.Out.
                  Diagnostics go to Console.Error. Exits 0 on EOF or
                  notifications/exit|shutdown. No network, no source mutation.
  --stdio <json>  One-shot JSON-RPC round-trip (test seam; kept for backward
                  compatibility). Writes the single response to Console.Out or
                  to the file passed with --output.

Methods:
  initialize, tools/list, tools/call, notifications/initialized, ping,
  notifications/exit (or notifications/shutdown).

Tools:
  ackit.scan, ackit.findings, ackit.context, ackit.health.
